assumptions: The problem is q_t+a q_x=0 with constant real a on a uniform grid.
The fully discrete difference_step uses forward Euler and switches between backward and forward differences according to the sign of C=a Δt/Δx.
For this linear periodic update, use |C|≤1 for stability and monotonicity. finite_difference alone is a spatial operator and does not specify a time integrator.
methods.units: q may have any consistent unit; x is length, t is time, and a is length/time. C=a Δt/Δx is dimensionless. Released periodic benchmarks are nondimensional.
methods.boundary_conditions: Periodic boundaries are imposed with np.roll. Inflow, outflow and wall boundaries require a separate ghost-state implementation.

limitations.ja: 空間・時間とも1次精度で、一般に波形や接触面を拡散させる。|C|>1ではこの陽的更新の安定性は保たれない。一定速度のスカラー例だけから、変係数・非線形系や多次元での保存性・安定性は保証しない。
limitations.en: First order in both space and time and generally diffusive for waves and contacts. The explicit periodic update is unstable for |C|>1. assumptions: The scope is one-dimensional hyperbolic conservation laws on a uniform Cartesian grid with a model-compatible numerical flux.
Euler assumes a perfect gas and positive density/pressure; HLLC and other Euler fluxes are available. Shallow-water and isothermal models require HLL or Rusanov in this solver.
solve(...,method='godunov') sets reconstruction slopes to zero and advances with SSPRK(3,3). Initial data are sampled at grid locations and used as cell values.
The released solver requires 0<CFL≤0.5; this bound alone is not a positivity guarantee for arbitrary inputs.
methods.units: Use units consistent with each model's conserved variables and fluxes. Euler uses density ρ, momentum density ρu and total energy density E; each flux has its conserved-variable unit times length/time. Released shock tubes are nondimensional.
methods.boundary_conditions: The released _pad supplies periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states, or edge extrapolation. Extrapolation is not an exact nonreflecting condition; reflecting walls and general inflow conditions are not implemented. Boundary fluxes contribute to global balances on nonperiodic domains.

limitations.ja: 空間1次なので衝撃波や接触面が広がる。原報の厳密Riemann解を用いる1段更新そのものではなく、時間3次でも全体の空間精度は1次のまま。近似流束・初期値の点サンプル・境界処理の選択に依存し、真空、乾湿境界、一般EOS、多次元および一般的な正値性・エントロピー保証は対象外。
limitations.en: First-order spatial reconstruction smears shocks and contacts. This is not the original one-step exact-Riemann algorithm, and third-order time stepping does not raise its spatial order. Results depend on the approximate flux, sampled initialization and boundary treatment. Vacuum, wet/dry fronts, general equations of state, multiple dimensions, and general positivity/entropy guarantees are outside scope.

assumptions: Left/right states are perfect-gas Euler variables (ρ,ρu,E), finite with ρ>0 and p>0, using a physical γ>1.
Outer speeds are S_L=min(u_L−c_L,u_R−c_R) and S_R=max(u_L+c_L,u_R+c_R); the contact speed and two star states are computed algebraically.
HLLC supplies an interface flux. Reconstruction, time integration, CFL control and boundary states are provided by the caller.
The local HLLC branch accepts Euler only; availability of HLL for another model does not make this HLLC implementation applicable to it.
methods.units: Use one consistent unit system on both sides. ρ is density, u, c and wave speeds are length/time, and p and E are energy/volume. Numerical fluxes have conserved-variable units times length/time. γ is dimensionless; released examples are nondimensional.
methods.boundary_conditions: Physical boundary conditions do not belong to the interface-flux function. The caller constructs left/right states; the existing one-dimensional solver uses periodic, fixed-initial-endpoint or extrapolated-edge states.

limitations.ja: 接触波の復元は一般的な正値性・エントロピー安定性の保証ではない。このDavis型波速版を、強い希薄波・真空や一般EOS、MHD、相対論的流体に追加処理なしで用いない。静止接触の一致テストも、移動衝撃波や全問題での厳密性を意味しない。
limitations.en: Contact restoration is not a general positivity or entropy-stability guarantee. This Davis-speed version should not be extended without additional treatment to strong rarefactions, vacuum, general equations of state, MHD or relativistic flow. Exact agreement for a stationary contact does not imply an exact solution for moving shocks or arbitrary problems.

assumptions: The scope is one-dimensional perfect-gas Euler on a uniform Cartesian grid, with finite positive density and pressure at each stage.
q contains point values, not cell averages. A global a=max|u±c| splits f±=(f±a q)/2; oppositely biased five-point stencils reconstruct the two fluxes.
Weights use d=(0.1,0.6,0.3), Jiang–Shu β_k, τ_5=|β_0−β_2| and α_k=d_k[1+(τ_5/(ε+β_k))²], with default ε=10^-6.
Both split fluxes use the same face-frozen Roe characteristic basis by default; component reconstruction is optional. Time integration is SSPRK(3,3), with 0<CFL≤0.5.
methods.units: Released Euler examples are nondimensional. With dimensional data, β and τ scale as the squared projected flux, so the effect of a fixed ε=10^-6 changes with scaling. Nondimensionalize states/fluxes or choose a scale-consistent ε. Use compatible units for Δt, Δx and wave speed.
methods.boundary_conditions: reconstruction._pad uses periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states or edge extrapolation. Uniform high-order boundary accuracy and nonreflection are not guaranteed.

limitations.ja: 5次は滑らかな領域での空間精度であり、時間は3次。不連続近傍で同じ次数は期待できず、ε・尺度・基底の影響を受ける。段階で非正値になると時間刻みを半減して再試行するが、これは正値性の定理ではない。WENO分岐はHLLCを使わず、有限体積PPM/MUSCL用の正値再構成スケーリングも使わない。
limitations.en: Fifth order refers to smooth-region spatial accuracy; time accuracy is third order. The same order is not expected near discontinuities, and ε, scaling and basis matter. Invalid stages trigger step halving and retries, which do not constitute a positivity theorem. The WENO branch uses neither HLLC nor the positive-reconstruction scaling used by the finite-volume PPM/MUSCL branch.

supports.en: Primary order-condition formulation, with the fourth-order discussion inspected. This is not presented as the historical invention paper for classical RK4.

verification.locator: Runge–Kutta definitions and p. 196 fourth-order conditions; relevant portions read, not every proof.

assumptions: The target is the initial-value problem y'=f(t,y), with sufficient smoothness of f and y for fourth-order convergence.
The adopted classical tableau has c=(0,1/2,1/2,1), a21=1/2, a32=1/2, a43=1 and b=(1,2,2,1)/6.
The caller selects the step. A semidiscrete PDE also imposes spatial spectral/CFL restrictions; linear modes require |R(hλ)|≤1.
methods.units: h and t have the same time unit, and f_i has units y_i/time. State-component units belong to the problem; RK4 imposes no intrinsic physical unit. hλ is dimensionless.
methods.boundary_conditions: Spatial boundary conditions do not apply to the ODE step itself. For a PDE, each stage's RHS evaluation must supply the appropriate boundary values or ghost states.

limitations.ja: 陽解法でA安定・L安定ではなく、硬い減衰では小さい刻みを要する。一般の非線形問題に正のSSP係数を持たず、正値性・TVD性・エネルギー保存・シンプレクティック性を4次精度から導くことはできない。このrk_stepは固定刻みの部品で、埋込み誤差推定や自動刻み調整を持たない。
limitations.en: Explicit RK4 is neither A-stable nor L-stable and may require small steps for stiff decay. It has no positive general nonlinear SSP coefficient; fourth-order accuracy implies neither positivity, TVD, energy conservation nor symplecticity. The released rk_step is a fixed-step component without an embedded error estimator or adaptive controller.

title.ja: 反応拡散：空間2次と時間4次を分けて測る
title.en: Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time

summary.ja: 線形の拡散・反応演算子を、連続と半離散のFourier厳密解を用いて小規模に検証します。
summary.en: Validate a small linear diffusion-reaction operator against continuous and semidiscrete Fourier solutions.

assumptions.ja: 周期区間[0,2pi)、D=0.1、r=0.1、初期cos(2x)、終了t=2。格子16/32/64と、別の固定格子で刻み0.5/0.25/0.125を用います。
assumptions.en: Periodic[0,2pi), D=0.1,r=0.1, initial cos(2x), final t=2. Use grids 16/32/64 and a separate fixed-grid timestep sequence 0.5/0.25/0.125.

algorithm.ja: 周期中心2階差分と独自RK4で進めます。空間系列は小さな同一時間刻み、時間系列は同じ空間演算子を用います。
algorithm.en: Advance original periodic second-centered differences with RK4. The spatial sequence uses one small time step; the temporal sequence fixes the spatial operator.

validation.ja: 連続固有値r-Dk²への最大誤差で空間次数、半離散固有値r-4Dsin²(kdx/2)/dx²への最大誤差で時間次数を測ります。独立した解析参照であり同じ実装の細格子値を参照にしません。
validation.en: Measure spatial order against r-Dk² and temporal order against r-4Dsin²(kdx/2)/dx². Both are independent analytic references, rather than a finer-grid run of the same solver.

limits.ja: 線形・周期・滑らかな単一モードだけを検証します。非線形のFisher前線、複雑境界、空間生態系や一般の反応ネットワークの検証ではありません。
limits.en: Only a linear, periodic, smooth single mode is verified. Nonlinear Fisher fronts, complex boundaries, spatial ecosystems and general reaction networks remain outside scope.

review.ja: 公式の行列指数APIとPadé/scaling-and-squaring法の記載を確認。
review.en: Official matrix-exponential API and description of the Pade/scaling-and-squaring method checked.

title.ja: Turing不安定性：線形成長率と小振幅パターン
title.en: Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns

summary.ja: Schnakenberg型反応拡散で、一様平衡の安定性と拡散による選択モードの成長を行列指数で検証します。
summary.en: Use a matrix exponential to validate stable homogeneous kinetics and diffusion-driven growth of a selected Schnakenberg mode.

assumptions.ja: 無次元a=0.1,b=0.9、平衡(1,0.9)、拡散係数(0.01,1)、周期k=2、初期振幅1e-4。線形t=1と非線形t=4の短い計算に限定します。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless a=0.1,b=0.9, equilibrium(1,0.9), diffusivities(0.01,1), periodic k=2 and initial amplitude1e-4. Restrict runs to linear t=1 and nonlinear t=4.

algorithm.ja: 独自の中心差分・RK4で線形化PDEと短い非線形PDEを進めます。3格子でのモード振幅と成長率、非線形の濃度最小値・初期パターン増幅を記録します。
algorithm.en: Advance the linearized and short nonlinear PDEs using original centered differences/RK4. Record mode amplitudes/growth on three grids, minimum concentrations and early-pattern amplification.

validation.ja: 連続Fourier行列J-k²DのSciPy expmと線形数値解を比較し空間収束を測定。非線形計算は半離散線形行列指数との小振幅差を測り、成熟模様の参照照合とは区別します。
validation.en: Compare linear numerical fields with SciPy expm of continuum J-k²D and measure spatial convergence. Quantify the nonlinear run against a semidiscrete linear matrix exponential as a small-amplitude check, not validation of mature morphology.

limits.ja: 1つの平衡近傍の発生段階です。原著係数や原著実験の再現、成熟模様、ランダム擾乱からの波数選択、実生物の較正は主張しません。
limits.en: One near-equilibrium onset experiment. No claim reproduces original-paper parameters/experiments, mature patterns, wavenumber selection from random noise or biological calibration.

summary.ja: 2変数の膜興奮縮約ODEを電流パルスで励起し、DOP853との全出力時刻の誤差・時間収束・回復を確認します。
summary.en: Excite a two-variable reduced membrane ODE with a current pulse; check all-output-time errors, temporal refinement and recovery against DOP853.

assumptions.ja: 無次元a=0.7,b=0.8,tau=12.5。I=0の休止平衡からt=10〜20だけI=0.8を与え、t=80まで進めます。生理学的な物理単位への較正はしません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless a=0.7,b=0.8,tau=12.5. Start at resting equilibrium for I=0, apply I=0.8 only during t=10..20 and integrate to t=80. No calibration to physiological physical units.

algorithm.ja: 独自RK4を刻み0.1/0.05/0.025で使用し、パルスの不連続点で時間区間を厳密に分割します。出力刻み0.1でピークと休止状態からの距離も測定します。
algorithm.en: Use original RK4 with steps 0.1/0.05/0.025, splitting time intervals exactly at pulse discontinuities. At output spacing 0.1, measure the peak and distance from rest.

validation.ja: 別実装SciPy DOP853のrtol1e-11と1e-13を比較して参照の感度を確認し、厳しい参照への最大解誤差と時間次数を評価します。ピーク時刻は出力格子上の精度です。
validation.en: Compare separate SciPy DOP853 at rtol=1e-11 and 1e-13 to check reference sensitivity; measure maximum solution error and time order against the tighter reference. Peak time is resolved only on the output grid.

limits.ja: FHN/BVP型の縮約ODEの限定検証です。HH全イオンチャネル、空間軸索、患者データ、実測電気生理の再現を含みません。
limits.en: Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE. It excludes full HH ion channels, spatial axons, patient data and experimental electrophysiology reproduction.

assumptions: The target is an ODE y'=f(t,y) represented by a real one-dimensional array, with a consistent Jacobian ∂f/∂y supplied by the caller.
A=[[γ,0],[1−γ,γ]], b=(1−γ,γ), c=(γ,1), and γ=1−1/√2. This stiffly accurate form returns the last stage.
With exact stage solves, R(z)=[1+(1−2γ)z]/(1−γz)^2. This γ gives A-stability and R→0 as |z|→∞ in the left half-plane.

Newton convergence is required at each stage. Distinguish fixed-step integrate from adaptive_sdirk2, which estimates error from (two half steps−one full step)/3 and accepts the two-half-step solution.
methods.units: h has time units, f_i has y_i/time, and J_ij has y_i/(y_j×time). Nondimensionalization or component scaling is needed: the fixed Newton tolerance 2×10^-12 does not automatically adapt to arbitrary physical units. Adaptive atol sets state scales and rtol is dimensionless.
methods.boundary_conditions: Spatial boundaries do not apply to the ODE time step itself. For semidiscrete PDEs, incorporate boundary conditions and their time dependence consistently into the RHS and Jacobian.

limitations.ja: L安定性は正確な段階解を前提とする線形試験方程式の性質であり、大刻みの精度・非線形収束・正値性を保証しない。Newton失敗時は固定版が例外、適応版が試行棄却を行う。埋込み対ではなくステップ倍化で、rtol/atolは局所誤差尺度であり最終大域誤差の保証ではない。一般DAE、質量行列、イベント処理は未実装。
limitations.en: L-stability concerns the linear test equation with accurate stage solves; it guarantees neither large-step accuracy, nonlinear convergence nor positivity. A Newton failure raises in the fixed version and rejects a trial in the adaptive wrapper. Adaptivity uses step doubling, not an embedded pair; rtol/atol control a local error scale, not a guaranteed final global error. General DAEs, mass matrices and events are not implemented.

assumptions_ja: 対象は実数の1次元配列で表すODE y'=f(t,y)。整合するJacobian ∂f/∂yを呼び出し側が与える。

assumptions: The released example is an autonomous separable one-degree-of-freedom Hamiltonian H(q,p)=p²/2+V(q) with unit mass and V=q²/2 or q²/2+q⁴/4.
The force is −V'(q), depending only on position. The update is p_half=p−h V'(q)/2, q_new=q+h p_half, p_new=p_half−h V'(q_new)/2.
Reversibility and symplecticity refer to the same fixed-step map. Dynamical time scales must still be resolved for accuracy and stability.
methods.units: The released oscillator is nondimensional with m=1 and harmonic ω=1. A general-mass formulation would require drift h p/m and consistent position, momentum, force and time scales; that generalization is not an input feature of this released function.
methods.boundary_conditions: Spatial boundary conditions do not apply to this oscillator phase-space map. It is a different problem from the original periodic Lennard-Jones fluid; particle periodicity, walls and constraints are not implemented here.

limitations.ja: 元のHamiltonianを各ステップで厳密保存するわけではない。シンプレクティックでも大刻みは不安定になり得て、ω=1の調和振動子では|h|<2が安定域の内部。速度依存力、摩擦・サーモスタット、拘束、一般の可変刻みや非分離Hamiltonianでは、同じ性質をそのまま保証できない。公開関数は一般分子動力学solverではない。
limitations.en: The original Hamiltonian is not exactly preserved at each step. A symplectic map can still be unstable at large steps; for the ω=1 harmonic oscillator, |h|<2 is the interior stability interval. Velocity-dependent forces, friction/thermostats, constraints, generic variable steps and nonseparable Hamiltonians require different treatment. This function is not a general molecular-dynamics solver.

assumptions: The operator must be real SPD and the right-hand side finite; the example discretizes constant-coefficient −Δu=f on a uniform square grid.

methods.units: CG has no intrinsic physical unit. The public Poisson coordinates have unit dimensionless length; dimensionally [f]=[u]/[length]². Residual norms are unweighted array norms.
methods.boundary_conditions: CG itself supplies no physical boundary condition. The public 2D Poisson examples impose u=0 on every side of [0,1]² by zero padding.

limitations.ja: 非対称・不定・特異な系にそのまま適用しない。前処理、一般疎行列入力、純Neumannの零空間処理はこのCG例にはない。小さい残差は離散化誤差の保証ではなく、単一固有モードの速い終了を一般的性能と解釈しない。
limitations.en: Do not apply this variant directly to nonsymmetric, indefinite or singular systems. A small residual does not certify discretization accuracy; rapid termination for one eigenmode is not a general performance result.

assumptions: The caller supplies F and its Jacobian; the basic setting is a square differentiable system with a nonsingular Jacobian near the root.
Starting at one, the step is halved until ||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂; failure is returned below α=2⁻²⁰.
The GMRES path still uses an explicitly supplied Jacobian; CSR uses ILU(0), otherwise Jacobi preconditioning. Inner and outer absolute residual criteria differ.
methods.units: No intrinsic physical unit; the caller defines unknown and residual scales. Components are not nondimensionalized automatically, so scale them consistently before using the norm and absolute tolerance.
methods.boundary_conditions: Newton has no intrinsic physical boundary. F/Jacobian assembly supplies it; the existing Bratu test encodes zero Dirichlet values at both ends of [0,1].

limitations.ja: 初期値、Jacobianの非特異性、残差の尺度に依存し、大域的収束は保証しない。特異な密行列解法や前処理構築は例外となることがあり、すべてが失敗理由の戻り値に変換されるわけではない。行列なしJv、信頼領域、継続法は備えない。
limitations.en: Convergence depends on the initial guess, Jacobian nonsingularity and residual scaling; global convergence is not guaranteed. Singular dense solves or preconditioner construction may raise exceptions rather than return a failure reason. No matrix-free Jv, trust region or continuation is provided.

assumptions: Positions are finite (N,3), masses positive and finite, and N≥1; ε=softening>0, theta≥0 and order is 0 or 2.
A node is accepted when s/d<theta, with s=2×half and d measured to its center of mass. Target-containing cells are always opened; leaves exclude self terms.
The acceleration kernel is −m r/(r²+ε²)^(3/2). order=2 adds the full Taylor term from S=Σmδδᵀ, retaining trace(S) for the softened kernel.
methods.units: Dimensionless G=1. Positions and softening share a length unit and masses use one consistent unit. With scales L₀,M₀, acceleration is restored with GM₀/L₀².
methods.boundary_conditions: Isolated boundaries without periodic images; the softened potential −Gm/√(r²+ε²) tends to zero at infinity. This is a different boundary problem from periodic PM, Ewald or TreePM.

limitations.ja: 静的な力の教育例で、時間積分・宇宙膨張・周期境界・FMMを含まない。thetaは厳密な誤差上限ではなく、order=2がすべての配置で常に改善する保証もない。対象ごとの近似なので厳密な作用反作用・全運動量保存は保証せず、相互作用回数は実時間や全分布でのO(N log N)の実測ではない。
limitations.en: A static-force educational example without time integration, expansion, periodic images or FMM. theta is not a rigorous error bound, and order=2 need not improve every configuration. Targetwise approximation does not guarantee exact action–reaction/total-momentum conservation. Interaction counts are not timings or empirical complexity guarantees for every distribution.

assumptions: A cubic periodic box, positive finite particle masses, finite positions, cubic n³ mesh with n≥4 and L>0; coordinates wrap modulo L in every axis.
CIC deposits to eight vertices with product-linear weights divided by cell volume; interpolation uses the same weights. No CIC-window deconvolution is applied.
∇²φ=4πG(ρ−meanρ), with φ̂(0)=0. Nonzero modes use −4πG/k² and acceleration is −∇φ. On even meshes, each derivative zeroes its own-axis Nyquist mode to retain a real odd operator.
methods.units: pm_acceleration is a dimensionless G=1 example. L and positions share a length unit; density, potential and acceleration scale as M/L³, GM/L and GM/L². Only the lower-level periodic_poisson accepts a positive gravity parameter.
methods.boundary_conditions: Periodic in all directions with box length L. Mean removal enforces periodic-Poisson compatibility, while zeroing k=0 fixes the additive potential gauge. This is not the isolated-force problem.

limitations.ja: 格子以下の近接力を直接補正しないPMのみの静的例。CIC平滑化、格子異方性・aliasing・有限解像度があり、連続Fourier Green関数を有限差分Laplacianの離散逆作用素と混同しない。P3M・TreePM分割・Ewald・PME/SPME・宇宙膨張・時間積分は含まない。
limitations.en: A static PM-only example without direct short-range correction. CIC smoothing, grid anisotropy, aliasing and finite resolution remain; the continuum Fourier Green function is not the inverse symbol of a finite-difference Laplacian. No P3M, TreePM split, Ewald, PME/SPME, expansion or time integration is included.

assumptions: One electron in the Coulomb potential -Z/r of an isolated, infinite-mass point nucleus; nonrelativistic and field-free.

A uniform interior radial grid and a real symmetric tridiagonal second-order kinetic operator are used.

assumptions: Atomic branch: Nonrelativistic isolated He with Z=2, an infinite-mass point nucleus and two opposite-spin electrons occupying the same spherical 1s spatial orbital.
Atomic branch: Normalize integral |u|^2 dr=1 and define p=2|u|^2=4 pi r^2 n, so integral p dr=2.
Atomic branch: For this occupied orbital only, the Fock equation reduces to the effective field -2/r+v_H/2 and E_x=-E_H/2; no general nonlocal Fock operator is implemented.
Atomic branch: Single-determinant exchange is included; electron correlation is omitted.
Separate molecular branch: H2 RHF in finite s-Gaussian spaces, analytic one-/two-electron integrals and matrix SCF; see the H2 input and measured checks for its own tolerances.
methods.units: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2). Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately.
methods.boundary_conditions: Helium reduced orbital: u(0)=u(r_max)=0, baseline r_max=16 bohr with a separate 4/8/12/16-bohr domain study. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: The fixed-point map is the released spherical He 1s² HF or exchange-only LDA radial model, not a general molecular or periodic SCF implementation.

Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Mix input and output radial number densities: p_next=(1-alpha)p_in+alpha p_out, 0<alpha<=1; released baseline alpha=0.35 and an alternative start uses 0.7.
Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Each eigenproblem normalizes u and sets p_out=2|u|^2, so the electron-number normalization is imposed within the iteration.

Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: Convergence requires input/output density L1<1e-9 electrons, |energy change|<1e-10 hartree, and the output-density-rebuilt orbital residual<1e-7 hartree; maximum 300 iterations.
Atomic/molecular examples: Earlier helium branch: The atlas iteration implements no DIIS, Anderson or Newton acceleration. An independent PySCF reference may use its own solver algorithms.

Atomic/molecular examples: Separate molecular branch: H2 RHF in finite s-Gaussian spaces, analytic one-/two-electron integrals and matrix SCF; see the H2 input and measured checks for its own tolerances.

Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
methods.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Mixing alpha and iteration number are dimensionless. Radial p is in bohr^(-1), integral |p_out-p_in| dr is electron number, and energy changes/normalized orbital residuals are in hartree. Published tolerances belong to this normalization and model. Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
methods.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: SCF mixing itself imposes no spatial boundary condition. The supplied helium fixed-point map uses reduced-orbital u(0)=u(r_max)=0 and an isolated finite-origin, N/r Hartree field; see the HF/KS/Hartree records. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

limitations.ja: 原子・分子の実行例の範囲：エネルギー変化だけで収束を宣言しない。電子数が2に保たれることは実装の整合性検査であり、独立な物理検証ではない。異なる初期値での一致も解の一意性・軌道安定性・大域的最低エネルギーを証明しない。Pulay文献は未採用の加速法の文脈用で、単純密度混合の実装出典ではない。 H₂では別の分子積分実装を用いる。分子DFT・一般多中心分子・開殻・軌道安定性解析は未実装。 周期He側では別のPySCFドライバーがVWN5相関と周期k点積分を扱う。
limitations.en: Atomic/molecular example scope: Energy change alone is insufficient. Electron number staying at two is an imposed consistency check, not independent physical validation. Agreement from alternative starts does not prove uniqueness, orbital stability or a global energy minimum. The Pulay reference is context for an unimplemented acceleration method, not the source of the simple density-mixing implementation. H₂ uses a separate molecular-integral implementation. Molecular DFT, general multicenter molecules, open shells and orbital-stability analysis remain unimplemented. A separate PySCF periodic-He driver additionally uses VWN5 correlation and periodic k-point quadrature.

assumptions: A nonnegative spherically symmetric electron-number density n(r), with p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) and integral p dr=N; released helium uses N=2.
For an isolated system, v_H(r)=integral_0^R p(s)/max(r,s) ds and E_H=(1/2) integral p(r)v_H(r) dr.
The code uses uniform-grid cumulative quadrature with p=0 at the two endpoints and zero density outside the finite box; the same-radius quadrature sample is counted once.

v_H is positive electron repulsion and satisfies Laplacian(v_H)=-4 pi n in atomic units. Signed electronic charge density is -n; v_H is electron potential energy, not the electrostatic potential generated by that negative charge.
methods.units: Atomic units: r in bohr, n in bohr^(-3), p in bohr^(-1), N an electron number, v_H and E_H in hartree. The positive-number-density convention fixes the Poisson sign.
methods.boundary_conditions: Isolated spherical Coulomb boundary: v_H is finite at the origin and equals N/r outside the truncated density support. It is not a zero-Dirichlet condition at r_max. Endpoint p=0 is inherited from the reduced orbital; no periodic neutrality/background convention is implemented.

limitations.ja: 球対称・孤立・有限箱で切断した密度用の積分評価。非球対称、一般の境界形状、周期系、Ewaldや背景電荷、点電荷の特異自己エネルギーは扱わない。同半径標本の重複回避は求積の会計であり、DFTの物理的自己相互作用を除去する操作ではない。He HFでの自己相互作用相殺は別の交換簡約に由来する。
limitations.en: An integral evaluator for spherical isolated densities truncated in a finite box. It does not treat nonspherical/general boundaries, periodicity, Ewald/background charges or singular point-charge self-energies. Avoiding a double-counted same-radius sample is quadrature bookkeeping, not removal of DFT self-interaction; the helium-HF cancellation comes from the separate exchange reduction.

assumptions_ja: 非負・球対称の電子数密度n(r)を仮定。p(r)=4πr²n(r)、∫p dr=Nと定義し、公開He例はN=2。
孤立系のv_H(r)=∫₀ᴿp(s)/max(r,s)dsとE_H=(1/2)∫p(r)v_H(r)drを評価する。
一様格子の累積求積を用い、両端p=0、有限箱外の密度は0とする。同じ半径の求積標本を1回だけ数える。
v_Hは正の電子間反発で、原子単位系で∇²v_H=−4πn。符号付き電子電荷密度は−nであり、v_Hは負電荷が作る静電ポテンシャルそのものではなく電子のポテンシャルエネルギー。
methods.units_ja: 原子単位系。rはbohr、nはbohr⁻³、pはbohr⁻¹、Nは電子数、v_HとE_Hはhartree。正の電子数密度という規約とPoisson式の符号を組にする。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 孤立・球対称Coulomb境界。v_Hは原点で有限、切断した密度の外側ではN/r。r_maxで0とするDirichlet条件ではない。端点p=0は縮約軌道から与え、周期系の中性化・背景電荷の規約は実装していない。

caution.ja: Poisson解の残差、積分した電子数、遠方の挙動、二重計数の1/2を別々に確かめます。周期セルの帯電系を孤立系のエネルギーとして解釈しません。

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Use the total spin-unpolarized positive number density n=n_up+n_down, with n_up=n_down=n/2; in the radial example n=p/(4 pi r^2).
Atomic/molecular examples: The implemented exchange is E_x=-(3/4)(3/pi)^(1/3) integral n^(4/3) d^3r and v_x=delta E_x/delta n=-(3n/pi)^(1/3), hence E_x=(3/4) integral p v_x dr.
Atomic/molecular examples: Set E_c=v_c=0 explicitly. This is not LDA plus a correlation parameterization and not Slater X-alpha with an unspecified coefficient.
Atomic/molecular examples: The public execution uses spherical closed-shell He 1s² and independently compares the same exchange-only choice against PySCF with xc='LDA_X,'.

Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
methods.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Atomic units: total number density n in bohr^(-3), radial p in bohr^(-1), local v_x in hartree, and integrated E_x in hartree. The energy functional and its derivative use the same density and spin convention. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
methods.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: The local exchange functional itself has no spatial boundary condition. The density/orbital problem supplies the isolated helium box and normalization. Gradient, nonlocal-exchange or periodic-functional boundaries are outside this implementation. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

assumptions: The initial validation specification is noncoincident point charges in a cubic, triply periodic Coulomb cell with zero net charge and no uniform neutralizing background.
Omit only i=j in the same cell (n=0); retain periodic self images and account separately for the self-energy correction.
Specify splitting, real cutoff and reciprocal/mesh parameters. The mean-potential gauge and the macroscopic surface convention are different choices.
Approximate structure factors with cardinal B-splines and matching Fourier correction/FFT normalization. Fourth-order (cubic) interpolation is an initial comparison candidate, not implemented code.
methods.units: Comparison convention: fixed length ℓ₀, charge q₀ and Coulomb prefactor kₑ; energy unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀ and force unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀². The splitting coefficient has inverse-length units. Do not mix reduced kₑ=1 and SI conventions or reuse gravitational-PM signs.
methods.boundary_conditions: Triply periodic neutral cell; the initial comparison specifies a conducting (tin-foil) exterior with zero macroscopic surface term and separately fixes the mean-potential gauge. Vacuum-exterior, slab and isolated-boundary results are different problems.

assumptions_ja: 最初の検証仕様は、立方体セル内の重なりのない点電荷と3次元周期Coulomb相互作用です。総電荷はゼロとし、一様中和背景は含めません。
同一粒子の同一セル項（i=j, n=0）のみを除外し、自己の周期像との相互作用は残します。自己エネルギー補正を別に扱います。

methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 3次元周期・中性セル。最初の比較では外部導体（tin-foil）規約で巨視的表面項をゼロとし、平均ポテンシャルを別途固定します。真空外部・slab・孤立境界の結果とは直接比較しません。

assumptions.ja: Ewaldと同じ中性立方セルと実空間項を使います。PME族のうちEssmannらのBスプライン変種を採用し、Dardenらの原法のLagrange補間とは区別します。
assumptions.en: The neutral cubic cell and real-space term match the Ewald example. The adopted PME-family variant uses Essmann-type B-splines, distinct from Darden’s original Lagrange interpolation.

algorithm.ja: 4次または6次のcardinal Bスプラインのテンソル積で電荷を格子化し、節点スプラインの離散構造因子補正、Gaussian Green関数、3次元FFTを組み合わせます。格子エネルギーを重みの位置微分で解析的に微分します。
algorithm.en: Tensor-product cardinal splines of order four or six spread the charges. Apply the nodal-spline discrete structure-factor correction and Gaussian Green function through 3D FFTs; analytically differentiate assignment weights for forces.

validation.ja: 16³・24³・40³格子と2つの次数で、直接Ewald逆空間和との差を記録します。Ewaldと実空間項・自己項を共有する部分も明示。最細格子の力はエネルギー差分とも比較し、全電荷の保持を確認します。
validation.en: Meshes 16³/24³/40³ and two orders are compared with directly summed Ewald reciprocal terms. Shared real/self terms are stated. Check finest-grid force derivatives by energy differences and verify assigned total charge.

limits.ja: 有限格子のaliasingにより、エネルギー勾配型の合力は厳密にはゼロでなく、その診断量を保存します。運動量保存・長時間MD・原法PME・最適化P³M・スラブ補正の検証ではありません。
limits.en: Finite-mesh aliasing permits nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant; that diagnostic is reported. No exact momentum conservation, long MD, original PME, optimized P³M or slab validation is claimed.
